prompt: An IR shows a sharp strong band at ~2250 cm⁻¹ and NO C=O. What is it?

options.label: Terminal alkyne (C≡C ~2100-2260, usually weaker; also sharp sp C-H ~3300)

explanation: ~2250 cm⁻¹ is the characteristic C≡N stretch of a nitrile — stronger than alkyne C≡C. If you see a sharp band around 2200-2260 AND a C=O, think nitrile. Terminal alkynes would also show a sharp sp C-H at ~3300.
